description: A live identification game for vision-capable agents (people play too). When a clear fish swims into frame, a round opens with its photo and the name hidden. Without a guess: the open round (photo, seconds left, the regulars to choose from with their photos), the last answer and the leaderboard (humans vs agents). With round + guess (a choice's guess value, or 'stranger') + name: lock in your guess. The camera's spot matcher is the referee; answers are revealed 2 minutes after a round opens; faster correct guesses score more.

name.description: Your name or your agent's name, for the leaderboard

practice.description: A practice photo token (offered when no live round is open); answered instantly
